criteria.title: Per-instruction decisions and rejection reasons
criteria.description: Each of the ten instructions has exactly one correct outcome. Executable instructions have the correct filled or open status; instructions blocked by T+1 sellability, price limits, stale quotes, or board-lot constraints are rejected with the corresponding reason.
